status: Fabricated record-error/lineage layer over real public simulation features; not real historical records or empirically estimated document reliability
calibration: ss_intf batch1 calibration groups, positive-sharing rows only
test: ss_intf batch2 test groups, positive sharing, at most1000 per class selected by a separate stable hash
nominal_record_generation: Each original source states the true cousin class with its declared reliability, otherwise chooses uniformly from other supported classes. This directly informative toy record is intentionally simplified.
fusion: Naive treats each document as independent. Provenance-aware counts a known, internally consistent origin once; contradictory known-origin groups and unknown lineage are ignored for fusion.
conformal: Both fused methods calibrated on nominal single-copy record generation; no recalibration on test shifts
verification: Select the binary claim-verification question with greatest entropy under the method's reference scores. Idealized oracle says whether the asserted degree is true; never used by the policy. Compare first-available question and an evaluation-only oracle upper bound.
interpretation: A dependence-sensitivity plumbing experiment, not a new method, biological realism, real-record effectiveness or scientific novelty claim
